title: Hydrostatic accepted-origin q(H) and tangent control
purpose: Measure the local SWAP bottom-interface exchange curve and accepted-trajectory bottom-head derivative around each column's own hydrostatic accepted origin, after RESP01D showed that actual first MODFLOW trial heads do not admit a response sample.

scope.transaction_policy: Existing profile unchanged; ordinary 8-retry production-reference transaction, no gate/tolerance changes
scope.origin_reset: Every probe begins from the identical pristine initialized accepted origin; candidates are discarded, never committed.

measurements: transaction accepted/rejected status, substeps, retries and rejection counters
integrated native bottom exchange and terminal bottom flux
published accepted trajectory derivative for SW_STEP_CONTROL_BOTTOM_HEAD (coordinate 5), with route/method/availability
state, temporal-history vector, storage and revision before/after

analysis.finite_difference: Compare centered +/-1e-8 m head perturbations only if both ordinary transactions accept; convert head perturbation through the fixture's verified metres-to-centimetres mapping. Label any slope as integrated exchange per prescribed bottom-head pressure unit.
analysis.tangent: Report derivative only if the transaction publishes it as available with accepted steps. It is not relabeled as a derivative with respect to MODFLOW head until the unit mapping is applied explicitly.
analysis.gates: Do not widen acceptance, force acceptance, or use a separate Reference-floor candidate.

implementation_boundary.changes: Isolated research fixture and probe only.

interpretation_limits: A local hydrostatic-origin response does not establish corrector success at the actual MODFLOW trial head.
This is not coupled E2E qualification and does not authorize changing predictor initialization.
No Hupsel, restart continuation or whole-domain mass qualification is claimed.
